mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen from -18.1 to -14.1 over four weeks; this own-series momentum persists as restrictions ease, lifting the next 28-day mean above the last 28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC rose from -18.1 at t-3w to -14.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is not above the last 28-day mean when t-0w RETAIL_REC exceeds t-3w by more than 3 points.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT crossing above -20 signals that transit-dependent trips are recovering; retail footfall follows with a two-week lag, raising RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT crosses above -20.0 percent change from baseline (t-1w -22.6 to t-0w -19.1)
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -22.6 to -19.1 while RETAIL_REC rose to -14.1
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is lower than last 28-day mean after TRANSIT exceeds -20.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is not higher when GROCERY_PHARM is positive and WORKPLACES is above -5.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is higher than last 28-day mean while TRANSIT stays below -20 and WORKPLACES below -5.
